title: Sets, Elements, Subsets and Cardinality
quickIdea: A set is fixed by membership alone. Count the commas at the top level to get the cardinality, and never read a nested set as its contents.
remember: A set is a collection of distinct objects; order and repetition are irrelevant, so {1, 2, 2, 3} and {3, 2, 1} are the same set and both have cardinality 3.
x in A says x is an element of A. A is a subset of B (A subset B) says every element of A is also an element of B.
A = B exactly when A subset B and B subset A. This is the standard way to prove two sets are equal.
The empty set has no elements: its cardinality is 0. It is a subset of every set, and it is the only set with cardinality 0.
The empty set and the set containing the empty set are different objects: the first has 0 elements, the second has 1 element, namely the empty set.
Nesting is not membership. If {2, 3} is an element of S then 2 is not an element of S unless S also lists 2 separately.
Every set is a subset of itself, and the empty set has exactly one subset, itself.
Set-builder notation {x in U : P(x)} is a rule, not a list; two different rules can describe the same set.
An element is not a subset of the set that contains it, and a subset is not an element unless it is listed as one.

example.prompt: S = {{empty}, 1, {2, 3}}. Find the cardinality of S, decide whether the empty set is an element of S, and decide whether {2, 3} is a subset of S.
example.work: Look at the top-level commas: there are three items, so the cardinality is 3. The first item is a set that contains the empty set, not the empty set itself, so the empty set is not an element of S. The third item is the set {2, 3}, whose elements are 2 and 3, and neither of those is in S.
example.answer: The cardinality of S is 3. The empty set is not an element of S. {2, 3} is an element of S but not a subset of S, because 2 and 3 are not elements of S.

gateAngle: GATE CS 1995 Q.1.20 gives exactly this shape and asks for the number of elements of the power set: the answer is 2 to the power of the number of top-level items.

variations.label: VERIFIED PYQ
variations.question: See GATE CS 1995 Q.1.20 in the linked PYQs: the set is {{empty}, 1, {2, 3}} and the options are 2, 4, 8 and none of the above.
variations.why: Three top-level elements, so the power set has 2 cubed elements. Counting 2, 3 and the empty set as separate top-level items would give a wrong power.

variations.label: ORIGINAL PYQ-STYLE QUESTION
variations.question: Let T = {empty, {empty}, {{empty}}}. Give the cardinality of T, and say whether the empty set is an element of T and whether {{empty}} is a subset of T.
variations.answer: Cardinality 3. The empty set is an element of T. {{empty}} is a subset of T, because its only element {empty} is in T.
variations.why: All three items are distinct objects: the empty set, a set containing it, and a set containing that. The third item is also a subset because its element is listed at the top level.

variations.label: CONCEPTUAL PRACTICE QUESTION
variations.question: How many subsets of {1, {2, 3}} contain 1?
variations.why: The set has two elements, so it has four subsets; exactly half of them contain the element 1, because each subset is decided by two independent in-or-out choices.

trap.what: Reading a nested set as if its contents were elements of the outer set, or confusing 'is an element of' with 'is a subset of'.
trap.why: Membership looks only one level deep. A set inside a set is one object, whatever it contains, and the empty set is a subset of everything while being an element of almost nothing.
trap.counterexample: For A = {{empty}}, the empty set is a subset of A but not an element of A: the only element of A is the set {empty}. For B = {empty} the empty set is both a subset and an element, which is why B cannot be used to tell the two relations apart.

check.question: S = {empty, {empty}}. Give the cardinality of S, the cardinality of its power set, and say whether {{empty}} is a subset of S.
check.answer: Cardinality 2, power set cardinality 4, and yes, {{empty}} is a subset of S.
check.explanation: The two elements are the empty set and the set containing the empty set. The power set of a 2-element set has 4 elements. The set {{empty}} has the single element {empty}, which is in S, so it is a subset.
